name: Four on the floor
notes: Classic 909 kick, offbeat open hats, clap on 2 and 4, and swung 16th hats with a little life in their level.
code:
setcpm(120/4)

drums: s("bd:3*4").bank("tr909").gain(0.65)
hats: s("[~ oh]*4").bank("tr909").gain(0.4)
shaker: s("hh*16").bank("tr909").gain(perlin.range(0.12, 0.3)).swingBy(1/48, 4)
claps: s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("tr909").gain(0.5).room(0.2)
